captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a straight cylindrical pipe segment designed for modular connections. It has a uniform outer diameter and a hollow interior running its entire length. One end of the tube features an internal recessed socket (female joint) with a slightly wider inner diameter to accommodate a mating male connector.
captions.instruction: Please design a parametric cylindrical pipe segment with a female press-fit joint on one end. Users should be able to configure the outer diameter, inner diameter, total length, joint depth, and joint clearance gap.
captions.factory: The script constructs the pipe using nested `difference()` operations on cylindrical primitives. An outer cylinder of `outerDiameter` and height `length` is first hollowed out by subtracting an inner cylinder of `innerDiameter`. A third cylinder, representing the female joint socket, is translated to the top end (`length - jointLength`) and subtracted to create a recessed inner ledge with a clearance-adjusted radius (`(outerDiameter/2 - ((outerDiameter/2 - innerDiameter/2)/2) + jointGap/2)`).
